fields.v: Queen's University, Software Analysis and Intelligence Lab (SAIL), Kingston, ON, Canada (all five authors)

Evaluates — repository mining: empirical study of 1,926 GitHub repositories hosting Claude Code plugin marketplaces (structure, commit types, co-evolution of components; RQ1-RQ3). No agent run; effect of plugins on agent output not measured

fields.v: Claude Code agent plugins and plugin marketplaces (marketplace.json; launched October 2025); no version

Plugin components (Table 1): commands/ (slash-command Markdown prompts), agents/ (custom agent definitions), skills/ (SKILL.md plus supporting files/scripts), hooks/ (lifecycle shell commands, hooks.json), .mcp.json, .lsp.json, settings.json, .claude-plugin/plugin.json manifest; marketplace.json catalogue. Threats: search completeness (public indexed files only); 10-star threshold (checked at 5 and 25 stars); snapshot of April 2026, young repos; Claude Code only; subjective manual labels; LLM classification bias and single run; agent detection is a lower bound. Gaps: semantic differencing, instruction linting, consistency checks between scripts and SKILL.md, automated propagation of interface changes; longitudinal follow-up; other agent platforms; human-AI collaboration over plugin lifecycle
